C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.hasDecEq
C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : {n : ℕ} → (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | _, ⊤,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, ⊥,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, rel r v,  ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, nrel r v, ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hnrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hand φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hor φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, ∀' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hall φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'
  | _, ∃' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hex φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.neg
C0_dependencies.content:
def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

| ⊤        => 0
| ⊥        => 0
| rel _ _  => 0
| nrel _ _ => 0
| φ ⋏ ψ    => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| φ ⋎ ψ    => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| ∀' φ     => φ.complexity + 1
| ∃' φ     => φ.complexity + 1

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.hasDecEq
C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : {n : ℕ} → (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | _, ⊤,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, ⊥,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, rel r v,  ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, nrel r v, ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hnrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hand φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hor φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, ∀' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hall φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'
  | _, ∃' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hex φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'

def qr : ∀ {n}, Semiformula L ξ n → ℕ
  | _, ⊤        => 0
  | _, ⊥        => 0
  | _, rel _ _  => 0
  | _, nrel _ _ => 0
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ    => max φ.qr ψ.qr
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ    => max φ.qr ψ.qr
  | _, ∀' φ     => φ.qr + 1
  | _, ∃' φ     => φ.qr + 1

  | _, nrel _ v => .biUnion .univ fun i ↦ (v i).freeVariables

  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)

  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : {n : ℕ} → (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | _, ⊤,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, ⊥,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, rel r v,  ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, nrel r v, ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hnrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hand φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hor φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, ∀' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hall φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'
  | _, ∃' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hex φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'

--src: Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Clique
/-- Adding an edge increases the clique number by at most one. -/
protected theorem CliqueFree.sup_edge (h : G.CliqueFree n) (v w : α) :
    (G ⊔ edge v w).CliqueFree (n + 1) := by
  contrapose h
  obtain ⟨f, ha⟩ := topEmbeddingOfNotCliqueFree h
  simp only [ne_eq, top_adj] at ha
  rw [not_cliqueFree_iff]
  by_cases mw : w ∈ Set.range f
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := mw
    use ⟨f ∘ x.succAboveEmb, f.2.comp Fin.succAbove_right_injective⟩
    intro a b
    simp_rw [Embedding.coeFn_mk, comp_apply, Fin.succAboveEmb_apply, top_adj]
    have hs := @ha (x.succAbove a) (x.succAbove b)
    have ia : w ≠ f (x.succAbove a) :=
      (hx ▸ f.apply_eq_iff_eq x (x.succAbove a)).ne.mpr (x.succAbove_ne a).symm
    have ib : w ≠ f (x.succAbove b) :=
      (hx ▸ f.apply_eq_iff_eq x (x.succAbove b)).ne.mpr (x.succAbove_ne b).symm
    rw [sup_adj, edge_adj] at hs
    simp only [ia.symm, ib.symm, and_false, false_and, or_false] at hs
    rw [hs, Fin.succAbove_right_inj]
  · use ⟨f ∘ Fin.succEmb n, (f.2.of_comp_iff _).mpr (Fin.succ_injective _)⟩
    intro a b
    simp only [Fin.val_succEmb, Embedding.coeFn_mk, comp_apply, top_adj]
    have hs := @ha a.succ b.succ
    have ia : f a.succ ≠ w := by simp_all
    have ib : f b.succ ≠ w := by simp_all
    rw [sup_adj, edge_adj] at hs
    simp only [ia, ib, and_false, false_and, or_false] at hs
    rw [hs, Fin.succ_inj]

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.neg
C0_dependencies.content:
def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)
C0_dependencies.compilationAlias:

  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum

  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

def hasDecEq : {n : ℕ} → (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | _, ⊤,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, ⊥,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, rel r v,  ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, nrel r v, ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hnrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hand φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hor φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, ∀' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hall φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'
  | _, ∃' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hex φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'

  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.hasDecEq
C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : {n : ℕ} → (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | _, ⊤,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, ⊥,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, rel r v,  ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, nrel r v, ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hnrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hand φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hor φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, ∀' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hall φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'
  | _, ∃' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hex φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'

  | _, φ ⋏ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hand φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hor φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, ∀' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hall φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'
  | _, ∃' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hex φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.hasDecEq
C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : {n : ℕ} → (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | _, ⊤,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, ⊥,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, rel r v,  ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, nrel r v, ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hnrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hand φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hor φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, ∀' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hall φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'
  | _, ∃' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hex φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'

  | _, rel _ v  => .biUnion .univ fun i ↦ (v i).freeVariables
  | _, nrel _ v => .biUnion .univ fun i ↦ (v i).freeVariables
  | _, ⊤        => ∅
  | _, ⊥        => ∅
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ    => freeVariables φ ∪ freeVariables ψ

  | _, ∀' φ     => freeVariables φ
  | _, ∃' φ     => freeVariables φ

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.neg
C0_dependencies.content:
def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
C0_dependencies.compilationAlias:

  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"

  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.complexity

def complexity {n : ℕ} : Semiformula L ξ n → ℕ
| ⊤        => 0
| ⊥        => 0
| rel _ _  => 0
| nrel _ _ => 0
| φ ⋏ ψ    => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| φ ⋎ ψ    => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| ∀' φ     => φ.complexity + 1
| ∃' φ     => φ.complexity + 1

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.hasDecEq
C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : {n : ℕ} → (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | _, ⊤,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, ⊥,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, rel r v,  ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, nrel r v, ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hnrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hand φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hor φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, ∀' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hall φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'
  | _, ∃' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hex φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'

def qr : ∀ {n}, Semiformula L ξ n → ℕ
  | _, ⊤        => 0
  | _, ⊥        => 0
  | _, rel _ _  => 0
  | _, nrel _ _ => 0
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ    => max φ.qr ψ.qr
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ    => max φ.qr ψ.qr
  | _, ∀' φ     => φ.qr + 1
  | _, ∃' φ     => φ.qr + 1

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.freeVariables
C0_dependencies.content:
def freeVariables : {n : ℕ} → Semiformula L ξ n → Finset ξ
  | _, rel _ v  => .biUnion .univ fun i ↦ (v i).freeVariables
  | _, nrel _ v => .biUnion .univ fun i ↦ (v i).freeVariables
  | _, ⊤        => ∅
  | _, ⊥        => ∅
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ    => freeVariables φ ∪ freeVariables ψ
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ    => freeVariables φ ∪ freeVariables ψ
  | _, ∀' φ     => freeVariables φ
  | _, ∃' φ     => freeVariables φ

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.neg
C0_dependencies.content:
def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, ⊥,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, rel r v,  ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, nrel r v, ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hnrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hand φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with

          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hor φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with

          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])

theorem not_ex_isQF (φ : L.BoundedFormula α (n + 1)) : ¬φ.ex.IsQF := fun con => by
  cases' con with _ con _ _ con
  · exact φ.not_ex_isAtomic con
  · exact not_all_isQF _ con

--src: Mathlib.ModelTheory.Equivalence
lemma bot_imp (φ : L.BoundedFormula α n) : ⊥ ⟹[T] φ := fun M v xs => by
  simp only [BoundedFormula.realize_imp, BoundedFormula.realize_bot, false_implies]

--src: Mathlib.ModelTheory.Graph
instance simpleGraph_model (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    @Theory.Model _ V G.structure Theory.simpleGraph := by
  letI := G.structure
  rw [Theory.simpleGraph_model_iff]
  exact ⟨G.loopless, G.symm⟩

--src: Mathlib.ModelTheory.Syntax
/-- Maps a bounded formula's symbols along a language equivalence. -/
@[simps]
def onBoundedFormula (φ : L ≃ᴸ L') : L.BoundedFormula α n ≃ L'.BoundedFormula α n where
  toFun := φ.toLHom.onBoundedFormula
  invFun := φ.invLHom.onBoundedFormula
  left_inv := by
    rw [Function.leftInverse_iff_comp, ← LHom.comp_onBoundedFormula, φ.left_inv,
      LHom.id_onBoundedFormula]
  right_inv := by
    rw [Function.rightInverse_iff_comp, ← LHom.comp_onBoundedFormula, φ.right_inv,
      LHom.id_onBoundedFormula]

theorem empty_theory_categorical (T : Language.empty.Theory) : κ.Categorical T := fun M N hM hN =>

  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.hasDecEq
C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : {n : ℕ} → (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | _, ⊤,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, ⊥,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, rel r v,  ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, nrel r v, ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hnrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hand φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hor φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, ∀' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hall φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'
  | _, ∃' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hex φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'

/--
`inferInstance` synthesizes a value of any target type by typeclass
inference. This function has the same type signature as the identity
function, but the square brackets on the `[i : α]` argument means that it will
attempt to construct this argument by typeclass inference. (This will fail if
`α` is not a `class`.) Example:
```
#check (inferInstance : Inhabited Nat) -- Inhabited Nat

def foo : Inhabited (Nat × Nat) :=
  inferInstance

example : foo.default = (default, default) :=
  rfl
```
-/

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : {n : ℕ} → (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | _, ⊤,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, ⊥,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, rel r v,  ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, nrel r v, ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hnrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hand φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hor φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, ∀' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hall φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'
  | _, ∃' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hex φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.neg
C0_dependencies.content:
def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

  | _, rel r v,  ψ => by

      case hrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>

        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with

          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])

  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum

  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.hasDecEq
C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : {n : ℕ} → (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | _, ⊤,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, ⊥,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, rel r v,  ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, nrel r v, ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hnrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hand φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hor φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, ∀' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hall φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'
  | _, ∃' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hex φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.hasDecEq
C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : {n : ℕ} → (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | _, ⊤,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, ⊥,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, rel r v,  ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, nrel r v, ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hnrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hand φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hor φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, ∀' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hall φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'
  | _, ∃' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hex φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'

  | _, ⊥        => 0

  | _, nrel _ _ => 0

  | _, φ ⋎ ψ    => max φ.qr ψ.qr
  | _, ∀' φ     => φ.qr + 1

def freeVariables : {n : ℕ} → Semiformula L ξ n → Finset ξ
  | _, rel _ v  => .biUnion .univ fun i ↦ (v i).freeVariables
  | _, nrel _ v => .biUnion .univ fun i ↦ (v i).freeVariables
  | _, ⊤        => ∅
  | _, ⊥        => ∅
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ    => freeVariables φ ∪ freeVariables ψ
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ    => freeVariables φ ∪ freeVariables ψ
  | _, ∀' φ     => freeVariables φ
  | _, ∃' φ     => freeVariables φ

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.neg

  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

def hasDecEq : {n : ℕ} → (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | _, ⊤,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, ⊥,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, rel r v,  ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, nrel r v, ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hnrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.hasDecEq
C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : {n : ℕ} → (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | _, ⊤,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, ⊥,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, rel r v,  ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, nrel r v, ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hnrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hand φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hor φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, ∀' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hall φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'
  | _, ∃' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hex φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.neg
C0_dependencies.content:
def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

  | falsum   => verum

  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

  (hverum  : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊤)
  (hfalsum : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊥)

  | _, and φ ψ  => hand φ ψ

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : ∀ n, Semiformula L ξ n → Sort w}
  (hverum  : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊤)
  (hfalsum : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊥)
  (hrel    : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (rel r v))
  (hnrel   : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (nrel r v))
  (hand    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋏ ψ))
  (hor     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋎ ψ))
  (hall    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∀' φ))
  (hex     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∃' φ)) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ
  | _, verum    => hverum
  | _, falsum   => hfalsum
  | _, rel r v  => hrel r v
  | _, nrel r v => hnrel r v
  | _, and φ ψ  => hand φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)
  | _, or φ ψ   => hor φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)
  | _, all φ    => hall φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)
  | _, ex φ     => hex φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : ∀ n, Semiformula L ξ n → Sort w}
  (hverum  : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊤)
  (hfalsum : ∀ {n : ℕ}, C n ⊥)
  (hrel    : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (rel r v))
  (hnrel   : ∀ {n k : ℕ} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n), C n (nrel r v))
  (hand    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋏ ψ))
  (hor     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ → C n ψ → C n (φ ⋎ ψ))
  (hall    : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∀' φ))
  (hex     : ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)), C (n + 1) φ → C n (∃' φ)) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (φ : Semiformula L ξ n), C n φ
  | _, verum    => hverum
  | _, falsum   => hfalsum
  | _, rel r v  => hrel r v
  | _, nrel r v => hnrel r v
  | _, and φ ψ  => hand φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)
  | _, or φ ψ   => hor φ ψ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ) (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex ψ)
  | _, all φ    => hall φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)
  | _, ex φ     => hex φ (rec' hverum hfalsum hrel hnrel hand hor hall hex φ)

def hasDecEq : {n : ℕ} → (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | _, ⊤,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, ⊥,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, rel r v,  ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, nrel r v, ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hnrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hand φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hor φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, ∀' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hall φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'
  | _, ∃' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hex φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

  | verum    => falsum

  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.hasDecEq
C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : {n : ℕ} → (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | _, ⊤,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, ⊥,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, rel r v,  ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, nrel r v, ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hnrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hand φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hor φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, ∀' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hall φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'
  | _, ∃' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hex φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.neg
C0_dependencies.content:
def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

  | falsum   => verum

  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

def hasDecEq : {n : ℕ} → (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | _, ⊤,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, ⊥,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, rel r v,  ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, nrel r v, ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hnrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hand φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hor φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, ∀' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hall φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'
  | _, ∃' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hex φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.neg
C0_dependencies.content:
def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)
C0_dependencies.compilationAlias:

  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum

  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.hasDecEq
C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : {n : ℕ} → (φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | _, ⊤,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, ⊥,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, rel r v,  ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, nrel r v, ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hnrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hand φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hor φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, ∀' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hall φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'
  | _, ∃' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hex φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.neg
C0_dependencies.content:
def neg {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → Semiformula L ξ n
  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum
  | rel r v  => nrel r v
  | nrel r v => rel r v
  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

  | falsum   => verum

  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

  | _, ⊤,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, ⊥,        ψ => by cases ψ using cases' <;>
      { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | _, rel r v,  ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, nrel r v, ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hnrel k₁ k₂ r₂ v₂ =>
        by_cases e : k₁ = k₂
        · rcases e with rfl
          exact match decEq r r₂ with
          | isTrue h  => by simp[h]; exact Matrix.decVec _ _ (fun i => decEq (v i) (v₂ i))
          | isFalse h => isFalse (by simp[h])
        · exact isFalse (by simp[e])
  | _, φ ⋏ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hand φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, φ ⋎ ψ,    r => by
      cases r using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hor φ' ψ' =>
        exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
        | isTrue hp =>
          match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
          | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
          | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
        | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | _, ∀' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hall φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'
  | _, ∃' φ,     ψ => by
      cases ψ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
      case hex φ' => simp; exact hasDecEq φ φ'

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

  | verum    => falsum
  | falsum   => verum

  | and φ ψ  => or (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | or φ ψ   => and (neg φ) (neg ψ)
  | all φ    => ex (neg φ)
  | ex φ     => all (neg φ)

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula.toStr
C0_dependencies.content:
def toStr {n} : Semiformula L ξ n → String
  | ⊤                         => "\\top"
  | ⊥                         => "\\bot"
  | rel (arity := 0) r _      => "{" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | rel (arity := _ + 1) r v  => "{" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | nrel (arity := 0) r _     => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "}"
  | nrel (arity := _ + 1) r v => "\\lnot {" ++ toString r ++ "} \\left(" ++ String.vecToStr (fun i => toString (v i)) ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋏ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | φ ⋎ ψ                     => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "  ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  | all φ                     => "(\\forall x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
  | ex φ                      => "(\\exists x_{" ++ toString n ++ "}) " ++ toStr φ
